from qiskit.circuit.library import grover_operator

qc.rz(0.6 * 0.5, 3)

qc.rz(0.6 * 0.5, 2)
qc.rz(0.6 * 0.5, 3)

# Apply CX gates in reverse order to unentangle qubits

qc.cx(1, 2)
